title: Introduction to Female Piety
subtitle: Female Piety — John Angell James and His Vision for Godly Womanhood
description: Meet John Angell James, the beloved pastor of Carrs Lane Chapel, and discover the heart behind his classic work Female Piety. Learn why this nineteenth-century shepherd believed that the cultivation of true religion in women was essential for the home, the church, and the whole of society.

title: The Importance of Female Piety
subtitle: Female Piety — Why Women's Spiritual Life Matters to All of Society
description: James argues that the spiritual condition of women shapes families, churches, and entire nations. Explore why the piety of women carries an influence out of all proportion to its visibility, and why the spiritual indifference of women is one of the gravest dangers any society can face.

title: The Character of the Pious Woman
subtitle: Female Piety — Virtue, Grace, and Inner Beauty
description: What does a truly godly woman look like from the inside out? James paints a rich portrait of the pious woman marked by humility, devotion to Scripture, prayerfulness, gentleness, and practical benevolence — the incorruptible ornament of a meek and quiet spirit.

title: Woman in the Home
subtitle: Female Piety — The Domestic Sphere as a Realm of Divine Calling
description: Far from a lesser calling, James reveals the Christian home as one of the most important institutions on earth. Discover the sacred dignity of domestic life and how the godly woman who builds her house with wisdom is engaged in a work that will outlast empires.

title: The Christian Mother
subtitle: Female Piety — Raising Children in the Nurture and Admonition of the Lord
description: James considered Christian motherhood one of the most sacred callings on earth. Explore the mother's role as first teacher, first example, and chief intercessor for her children's souls, and discover how maternal piety shapes generations yet unborn.

title: The Christian Wife
subtitle: Female Piety — Submission, Love, and Partnership in Marriage
description: Drawing from Ephesians 5 and Proverbs 31, James presents the biblical vision of the Christian wife — marked by reverence, trustworthiness, and a lifelong commitment to do her husband good. Includes tender counsel for women in difficult marriages.

title: Female Influence on Society
subtitle: Female Piety — How Godly Women Shape Culture and Community
description: James traces the vast, often invisible influence that godly women exert upon their communities and nations through personal relationships, charitable work, and moral example. From Deborah to Susanna Wesley, discover how female piety shapes the course of history.

title: Trials and Suffering
subtitle: Female Piety — Finding Grace in Affliction, with Puritan Strength
description: James addresses bereavement, sickness, wayward children, and poverty with the compassion of a seasoned pastor. Drawing from Watson, Flavel, and Sibbes, discover that the grace of God is sufficient for every trial and that Christ will never break the bruised reed.

title: The Devotional Life of a Godly Woman
subtitle: Female Piety — Prayer, Scripture Reading, and Meditation
description: James reveals the root that sustains every branch of female piety: a vibrant devotional life. Explore the disciplines of daily prayer, systematic Scripture reading, memorization, and Puritan-style meditation that nourish the soul and guard against spiritual decay.

title: The Legacy of Female Piety
subtitle: Female Piety — What Godly Women Leave Behind for Generations
description: In this final episode, James turns our eyes from earth to heaven. Discover the enduring legacy of godly women whose faith, prayers, and example ripple through generations — from Lois and Eunice to the faithful mothers of every age — and the eternal reward that awaits those who finish well.
